name: Python 3
updateContentCommand: U=archive.debian.org/debian && echo "deb http://$U bullseye main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list && sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Check-Valid-Until=false update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git-lfs && git lfs install && git lfs pull && sudo apt-get clean && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*; [ -f requirements.txt ] && pip3 install --no-cache-dir --user -r requirements.txt; pip3 install --no-cache-dir --user streamlit; echo '✅ Packages installed and Requirements met'
